nom: FRUDIA Blueberry Hydrating Air Fit Sunscreen

avis.texte: Saw a tiktok recommending this sunscreen and decided to try it out. I love it. The finish is a very natural dewy one, NOT oily like most sunscreens. The sunscreen feels light on the skin and I’m able to reapply without it feeling like it’s building up. The “blueberry” scent is very light in my opinion, I was a little hesitant about that but I don’t even notice it. This is my first time trying a sunscreen with the PA++++ on the label and I’ve yet to wear it out on a day where I’m in constant sunshine, but I trust that it would provide adequate protection. I recommend trying it out!

I've been using this for a few months now and really enjoy it. It is lightweight and doesn't leave a white cast. Gives me good protection in Hawaii weather. When I sweat though it does kind of run and make my face feel oily. I also like the light scent.
NO WHITE CAST. I thought it was a very thin, fluid consistency, but it’s not. I still like the texture because it’s not heavy.

avis.titre: Acne safe and will NOT burn your eyes
avis.texte: For reference, I have combo skin (oily t-zone and dry chin/cheeks), with hormonal acne. I use tretinoin roughly 3-4 days per week to help with the hormonal acne on my, chin and jawline, this has caused me to have some dry patches in those areas. I do not have sensitive skin or eyes, as I can use direct acids and most fragrances without irritation. I also have some slight pitting from acne scaring. I prefer unscented or lightly scented products and light weight/gel textured products when possible. For sunscreen, I prefer a matte or natural finish without heavy fragrance. I use a lotion for my first layer and a lotion or stick sunscreen for reapplication. This Frudia Acne-Safe SPF 50 PA++++ is uses the following UV filters; Ethylhexyl Methoxycinnamate (Octinoxate), Diethylamino Hydroxybenzoyl Hexyl Benzoate (Uvinul A Plus), Titanium Dioxide, and Ethylhexyl Triazone (Uvinul T150), so this is a hybrid sunscreen using both organic/chemical filters and titanium dioxide. So just keep this in mind if you have a preference for one filter or the other. The SPF comes in a 50g/1.76 ox container, which is fairly stand size for facial sunscreens, at a cost of $15.99 or $9.09 per ounce. I try to stay between $5-$15 per ounce for skincare, so this sits comfortably in the middle fo that range. I have acne prone, combo skin, so I am always interested in products that are marketed as "acne safe". avis.titre: The "cooling relief" burns my sensitive skinThe "cooling relief" burns my sensitive skin
avis.texte: I'm always looking for the perfect facial sunscreen that balances a lightweight feel, effectiveness, gentleness on my sensitive skin and a non-sticky, no white cast finish. I like the idea of a sunscreen that also includes CICA (one of my favorite skincare ingredients) and leaves out parabens, alcohol and animal products. The tube has a nice small nozzle opening that allows me to dispense carefully, which I appreciate. I hate it when I squeeze out too much sunscreen and waste product. The fragrance was mild to my nose and non-descript. The texture of the cream is light and easily spread, but left me with a noticeable tacky feeling that I wasn't expecting given the description saying that it has a non-sticky, lightweight finish. The tackiness does go away and my skin is left feeling fairly smooth, but I don't like the in between stage. It didn't leave a white cast on my skin. I didn't notice when ordering this that it contained three "cooling agents" (not menthol, but compounds with similar effects) as well as added fragrance. My skin is notoriously sensitive to anything with menthol or similar ingredients, so I patch tested this on my hand before proceeding to my face. Applied to my hand, I didn't experience any irritation or stinging (and, oddly, no cooling sensation whatsoever). When I moved onto my face, though, applying the two finger lengths recommended for sunscreen application, I had to wash it off quickly as I started developing a stinging sensation and increasing red

avis.titre: Simply the best sunblock and moisturizer
avis.texte: The best moisturizing sunblock I’ve ever had. Love the smell it’s light. It works a superior product. I’ve already ordered my second order.

avis.titre: Great lightweight sunscreen with maximum PA++++ UVA protectionGreat lightweight sunscreen with maximum PA++++ UVA protec
avis.texte: As a 43-year-old female, I do not really have major skin issues other than some tightness if I forget to apply lotion, so I am always looking for sun care that keeps my face feeling comfortable. I picked up this Korean sunscreen and it has been great. The PA++++ rating was not clearly marked on the packaging itself, so I ended up looking up the exact product details online to double-check. I was relieved to verify that it carries that four-plus rating, which means maximum UVA protection for being active outdoors. I actually realized after buying this that the sunscreen I have relied on for the past four years is also from the Frudia brand. I used their Blueberry Hydrating Air Fit sunscreen with that same top level of sun protection and have never gotten burned, so I already knew the brand was trustworthy. In the morning, I like to put on my lightweight rice glow serum first, let it dry, and then layer this on top. It locks in the moisture smoothly without feeling heavy or greasy. It has a slight minty or menthol-like scent when applied but nothing overpowering or that lingers on your skin. Checking out the ingredient list online was pretty reassuring too. Instead of just basic Centella extract, it relies on the complete concentrated Cica complex with Madecassoside, Asiaticoside, Madecassic Acid, and Asiatic Acid to quiet down skin redness and irritation. avis.titre: Good sunscreen but has that sunscreen smell + and added a lemon-y citrusy fragranceGood sunscreen but has that sunscreen
avis.texte: Nice sunscreen, does what it says to do but it does have that typical sunscreen base scent combined with a lemon-y citrusy scent. I enjoy the citrusy scent but I can't stand the sunscreen smell, think coppertone or banana boat. I thought the texture is really good, it goes on like a moisturizer and almost makes the skin shiny and glow-y. It spreads easy and isn't sticky. The sunscreen scent will linger though. It's marked as acne safe which is great - and best of all - even though the tube is small, I think it's very affordable and fairly valued, especially being 100% vegan.
I love the smell of this sunscreen. Feels comfortable wearing and stays put. I'm just a little confused on the expiration date (see photos)

The sunscreen felt good after applying because of how thin it is. It doesn't feel oily and was easy to apply. It has a good clean scent but not too strong. The bottle is compact and easy to put in your bag when you need it.

Not understanding why both the bottle and the box show an expiration date of 11.17.26, but a label was put over the factory printed date on the box showing an expiration date of 2.6.30. That's a huge difference.

There’s just the lightest scent of blueberry when applying, which I love! Squeeze out a little and smooth in. It disappears well into my skin, and feels light weight and not at all greasy. Love that it’s SPF 50.

Just got it and Cracked at the base . Also the smell is somewhere between stale and sickeningly sweet - not something fresh like I thought it would be, will be returning and not opting for a replacement

Sunscreen is a must. Especially on faces. Always on the lookout for a new one to live and this might be it. K skincare, rubs in easily, no white left behind, non oily and,.... Blueberry! Blueberry scented. So different. Smells good. Fells well on face. Smaller size great fit in the gin well sealed. No leaks. Caps tightly. Amazing expirationdate. Making this one probably a good one to stock up on.

I use this every morning because it feels light and blends quickly, leaving no chalky residue. It’s hydrating yet doesn’t weigh me down, though I wish it came in a bigger size. Overall, it’s my go-to for easy, everyday sun protection.

I've been trying out different sunscreens lately, particularly Korean brands and this one sounded great. I love blueberries and loved the sound on the skin-friendly ingredients. This is an SPF 50+ sunscreen with moisturizing and skin-soothing ingredients. It has a soft, slightly fruity smell that's clearly the blueberry. It's noticeable, but not strong. The sunscreen goes on with a lightweight but not liquidy texture and smooths on easily. I find it hard to tell if there's a white cast left since my skin is so pale, but it doesn't seem to leave one. For a little while after application, this leaves a bit of a tacky feeling but it sinks in nicely, given time. You might need to plan ahead to give it time if you're going to be applying makeup, though. This isn't my favorite sunscreen I've tried, but it's still good. I've not had a chance to give it an entire day's worth of high sun exposure since my life mostly involves running my kids around to school and activities and daily errands, but so far, so good!

This Frudia SPF 50 moisturizing lotion is to be blueberry, but I can not smell the blueberry. After reading the inactive ingredients, I see that fragrance is the last item, but it does contain vaccinium angustifolium, so this does contain blueberry. This goes on nice and smooth and does not leave any sticky, greasy, or oily residue after it's absorbed into the skin. It does dry pretty quickly, leaving your skin nice, soft, smooth, and protected against the sun, with little to no smell. Overall I think this is a quality sunscreen moisturizer, especially for my nose and face. I have not had any rash or irritation where this has been applied.

avis.titre: Not As Good as Some Other Japanese/Korean Sunscreens I've Used, but Still a Good Sunscreen
avis.texte: The Frudia Blueberry Hydrating Air Fit Sunscreen is a good option if you're looking for a facial suncreen that protects skin from UV, doesn't feel too heavy on the skin, and has a light, pleasantly fruity scent that doesn't linger too long. This sunscreen is markedly lighter than most American facial sunscreens, but heavier than other Asian facial sunscreens. It doesn't sink into your skin like some Asian sunscreens do, and it felt like something was on my skin. It's not terribly heavy though, and it plays well with makeup. For those sensitive to scents, the sunscreen does have a very distinctive smell that is pleasant, but definitely noticeable. It's a nice fruity scent that lingers for some time. While I didn't mind it, my daughter who is more sensitive to scents found it annoying after a while. Overall, it's a good sunscreen, but wouldn't be my everyday first choice simply because I know there are better options available.

-You get 1.76oz of Blueberry Face Sunscreen and it is made in Korea -This sunblock has a high SPF50 protection but it looks like a travel size -I use it as a last step of my skincare routine to protect my skin from the sun -I love that it leaves no white cast and is non sticky -It does contain fragrances and it has a blueberry scent to it
